import { defineConfig } from 'vite'
import { writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { devtools } from '@tanstack/devtools-vite'

import { tanstackStart } from '@tanstack/react-start/plugin/vite'

import viteReact from '@vitejs/plugin-react'
import tailwindcss from '@tailwindcss/vite'
import { nitro } from 'nitro/vite'
import { fonts } from '<font-kit>/src/index.mjs'

const config = defineConfig({
  resolve: { tsconfigPaths: true },
  plugins: [
    devtools(),
    nitro({ rollupConfig: { external: [/^@sentry\//] } }),
    ...(process.env.FONT_BENCH_MANUAL ? [] : [fonts()]),
    tailwindcss(),
    tanstackStart(),
    viteReact(),
    {
      name: 'benchmark-module-audit',
      generateBundle(_options, bundle) {
        if (this.environment?.config.consumer !== 'client') return
        writeFileSync('client-modules.json', JSON.stringify(Object.fromEntries(
          Object.entries(bundle).filter(([, entry]) => entry.type === 'chunk')
            .map(([file, entry]) => [file, Object.entries(entry.modules).map(([id, info]) => ({ id, renderedLength: info.renderedLength }))])
        ), null, 2))
      },
    },
  ],
})

export default config
